library.title: Report a vulnerability in confidence
library.intro: Report a vulnerability in a product, service or system used by the state or an essential service. It is kept restricted: only the national cybersecurity authority and the recipients it names see it, and the public sees a summary only after remediation and the disclosure date.
library.filled_by: The person or organisation reporting (they may stay anonymous where the law allows).
library.authority: The national cybersecurity authority the nation names (cyberAuthority slot, shipped empty).

nation_values.decision: CFG-SEC-009: when a notification or escalation is due, as the nation's law sets it; none ships

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it

Metadata only: the form's marking is checked against the installation's declared accreditation, and anything marked above it is refused, never stored; the content stays in an accredited system and only its reference is recorded
deviations.why: Catalogue Part 11 §3.3: an installation not accredited for a classification level must not store that class of information.
deviations.rule: lib/security/classification.ts markingRefusal(), also on every upload (lib/records/documents.ts addDocument())

deviations.what: The competent body is the institution the nation names for its slot of the deployment profile (cyberAuthority, criticalInfrastructure, securityAccreditation), shipped empty; who holds each power over a decision comes from the permit authority registry, proposed and unapproved
deviations.why: Authority comes from the deployment profile and the approved mappings, never a ministry by name; a production installation refuses a power no approved mapping covers.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: authorityFor(); lib/permits/decisions.ts SECURITY_PERMITS (plan I12)

deviations.what: A record is read only by an official named for it (need to know), for a stated purpose, for the action asked and, when marked, with a clearance at its level valid today; a clearance, a role or a seniority alone gives nothing; recipients see coordination terms only
deviations.why: Catalogue Part 11 §4.1 and §4.2: the clearance decision and the authorisation to access a specific record are separate controls.
deviations.rule: lib/auth/roles.ts securityAccessRefusal(); lib/security/access.ts readSecurityRecord() (every attempt in the access log)

deviations.what: No field records a source, a collection method, a target, an attacker or an attribution, and nothing computes a score: severity is the officials' choice on the nation's scale, with reasons; a risk estimate is the assessor's under a named methodology version
deviations.why: Catalogue Part 11 §5.3 and §6.2; plan I12 boundary: intelligence, attribution and scores about people are not built.

deviations.what: No step is decided by a model or a score: officials decide with reasons; AI never attributes an attack, accepts a risk, grants or withdraws a clearance or issues a directive
deviations.why: Catalogue Part 11 §11 prohibited default behaviour; AI never makes a legally material decision.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model (AI never makes a legally material decision)

deviations.what: Every decision is proposed by one official and confirmed by a different person; the platform's minimum adds suspensions, renewals and revocations whatever the procedure says
deviations.why: Catalogue Part 11 §10.1: separation of duties for sensitive approvals and protected changes.

deviations.what: Classification levels, incident categories, severity scales, sectors and criteria are the nation's configured lists or rules; none ship (a proposed list is marked proposed)
deviations.why: Catalogue Part 11 §3 and §12: CivicOS must not assume that security labels, clearance levels or handling rules are identical across jurisdictions.
